correctness.rationale: For every nonzero real diagonal A, both Rademacher sketches A*g and A*h have squared norm S2. A direct residual-projector expansion makes both XTrace basic estimates the same polynomial in xi_i=g_i*h_i, forcing the two-term empirical squared error to zero. Expanding the polynomial in orthogonal degree-two Walsh characters gives exact unbiasedness and the sum-of-squares risk. Its zero set is completely classified (rank <=1 or exactly two opposite nonzero entries). Exact rational independently evaluated projector formulas confirm 7,168 probe pairs across thirteen sample matrices. Finite tests do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The natural four-matvec XTrace procedure with independent Rademacher probes, including n>=5 below full input dimension, reports zero squared error for every sample of a full diagonal positive-definite family although the actual mean-squared trace error is strictly positive. This is a substantive stopping/uncertainty diagnostic boundary. It also reverses the expected advantage over classical one-probe Hutchinson, which is exact on every diagonal input. The exact sum-of-squares formula and zero-risk classification distinguish the cases requiring safeguards; no downstream theorem is asserted.
